name: Status Text
summary: A status label is one word sitting beside the thing it describes — Shipped, Failed, Waiting. It is too small for the usual fixes: no room for a sentence, no container to hang a live region on, nothing for a tooltip to attach to. So the word does the work, and the tick beside it only agrees.
demoNote: Examples 2 to 5 are live. Example 2 prints what four identical-looking labels are read out as; example 3 puts the reason for a failure in three places and only one survives; example 4 counts the announcements each list produces; example 5 squeezes the column until one of the two labels stops saying anything.
